================================================================
A build script is top-level statements, not declarations
================================================================

plugins {
    alias(libs.plugins.android.library)
    id("cogra.android.module")
}

android {
    namespace = "com.cogra.feature.topics"

    buildFeatures {
        compose = true
    }
}

================================================================
A settings script with nested blocks and a call on a receiver
================================================================

pluginManagement {
    includeBuild("build-logic")
    repositories {
        google {
            content {
                includeGroupByRegex("com\\.android.*")
            }
        }
        mavenCentral()
    }
}

dependencyResolutionManagement {
    repositoriesMode.set(RepositoriesMode.FAIL_ON_PROJECT_REPOS)
}

    id("cogra.android.module")

================================================================
A script mixes declarations with statements
================================================================

val versionName = "1.0"

tasks.register("x") {
    doLast {
        println(versionName)
    }
}

----

(source_file
  (property_declaration
    (variable_declaration
      (simple_identifier))
    (string_literal
      (line_string_literal)))
  (postfix_expression
    (postfix_expression
      (simple_identifier)
      (postfix_unary_suffix
        (navigation_suffix
          (member_access_operator)
          (simple_identifier))))
    (postfix_unary_suffix
      (call_suffix
        (value_arguments
          (value_argument
            (string_literal
              (line_string_literal))))
        (annotated_lambda
          (lambda_literal
            (statements
              (postfix_expression
                (simple_identifier)
                (postfix_unary_suffix
                  (call_suffix
                    (annotated_lambda
                      (lambda_literal
                        (statements
                          (postfix_expression
                            (simple_identifier)
                            (postfix_unary_suffix
                              (call_suffix
                                (value_arguments
                                  (value_argument
                                    (simple_identifier)))))))))))))))))))
